_about: Arnold J. Toynbee (1889-1975), historian: Greek Civilisation and Character, the Self-Revelation of Ancient Greek Society (Library of Greek Thought, 1924), his translations from Greek authors with an introduction. Its companion Greek Historical Thought (1924) is found only in 1950s reprints; his later works are not US public domain. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dd). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
